title: Rockstar hands GTA6 to Chinese podcasters, who call it the industry's peak
title_zh: R星请中国播客提前通关《GTA6》，主播直呼游戏工业天花板

image.credit: Photo by Keith Banks on Unsplash
image.author: Keith Banks

lead: A Chinese gaming outlet has played through GTA6 ahead of release, courtesy of an invitation from Rockstar Games. In a spoiler-free podcast episode, its hosts argue the blockbuster lives up to its billing as the summit of the game industry.
lead_zh: 一家中国游戏媒体在《GTA6》发售前受邀试玩通关。在一期无剧透播客里，几位主播认为这款大作配得上“游戏工业顶点”的说法。
preview: The episode, the 135th instalment of the outlet's freewheeling Gadio Wave podcast, gathered three contributors — Nadya, Xuedou and Bai Guang
preview_zh: 这期节目是机核旗下自由随性的电台栏目“Gadio Wave”第135期，Nadya、雪豆、白广大三位参与者聚在一起，讲述他们通关的体验。系列背后的开发商 Rockstar Games 提供了这次机会，几位主播也刻意避开剧情，只谈感受、不剧透，照顾还在等发售的听众。
paragraphs: The episode, the 135th instalment of the outlet's freewheeling Gadio Wave podcast, gathered three contributors — Nadya, Xuedou and Bai Guangda — to recount their completed playthrough. Rockstar Games, the studio behind the series, provided the access, and the hosts were careful to keep the discussion free of plot revelations, promising impressions rather than spoilers for listeners still waiting on launch.

A video version of the same conversation went out on Bilibili under the account Hediabo, with a presenter named Ximon weighing in on the title. Gadio Wave, as the outlet describes it, is a fast and loosely formatted show designed to capture first reactions to new games, films, books and music at speed, with no fixed release schedule and no fixed roster of hosts.

The timing is notable. The podcast surfaced roughly fifteen hours before publication, and the outlet's archive shows earlier coverage stretching back to 2022, when Rockstar confirmed that footage from an unfinished GTA title had leaked and said details of the new game would follow shortly. A later episode framed the anticipation bluntly, asking listeners whether they would let a parent go a week without food to buy them a copy.

For a Chinese audience, the significance lies less in the verdict than in the access. Pre-release hands-on time with a Rockstar title is rarely granted, and a domestic outlet's spoiler-free walkthrough lends the release a credibility that trailers cannot. Whether the finished game vindicates the hype will be settled by players, but the podcast's framing — the apex of an industrial craft — sets a high bar.

The episode drew more than 30,000 plays and around 99 comments within its first day, a measure of how closely Chinese players are tracking the release. The hosts closed by directing listeners to the Bilibili cut for a fuller verdict, positioning the audio show as a quick first take ahead of longer analysis.
paragraphs_zh: 这期节目是机核旗下自由随性的电台栏目“Gadio Wave”第135期，Nadya、雪豆、白广大三位参与者聚在一起，讲述他们通关的体验。系列背后的开发商 Rockstar Games 提供了这次机会，几位主播也刻意避开剧情，只谈感受、不剧透，照顾还在等发售的听众。
同一场对谈的视频版发布在 Bilibili 的“核电波”账号上，主持人西蒙也谈了对本作的看法。按机核自己的说法，Gadio Wave 是一档节奏快、形式松散的节目，力求第一时间分享对游戏、影视、书籍和音乐的新鲜感受，没有固定更新时间，也没有固定主持阵容。
时间点值得注意。这期播客上线约十五小时前发布，而机核的往期内容可以追溯到2022年——当时 Rockstar 确认一款未完成的《GTA》作品影像遭到泄露，并表示新作详情将很快公布。后来还有一期节目把玩家的期待说得很直白，问听众会不会让父亲一周不吃饭，只为给自己买一份游戏。
对中国受众而言，意义与其说在于评价，不如说在于“拿到资格”。R星作品发售前的试玩机会向来罕见，国内媒体能做一期无剧透通关分享，带来的可信度是预告片给不了的。成品能否撑起热度要由玩家定夺，但“工业技艺顶点”这个说法，已经把标准定得很高。
这期节目上线首日播放量超过3万，评论约99条，可见中国玩家对这次发售的关注程度。主播们在结尾引导听众去看 Bilibili 的视频版以获取更完整的评价，把音频节目定位成长篇分析之前的快速初评。
